records.text: Owens asked why Andrew Kolvet was allegedly at the White House meeting top brass the day before a partial Epstein files release; she said two White House sources emailed her and recalled posting, 'I don't know what this means, but I'm hearing Andrew Kolvet's at the White House.'
records.speaker: Candace Owens
